GeoCamOff needs the following permissions to work properly:

%1$s

These permissions are required to monitor camera usage and location-based restrictions.

GeoCamOff uses accessibility service to monitor camera app usage across the system. This allows the app to detect when camera applications are opened and apply location-based restrictions as needed. The service only monitors camera-related apps and does not access personal data.
GeoCamOff needs overlay permission to display warnings when camera access is restricted in certain areas.
Background location access is required to monitor restricted areas even when the app is not actively being used.
Boot completed permission allows GeoCamOff to automatically start monitoring after device restart.
